texts.objective.kaeltekammer.investigate: Sector 0 / inspect cold chamber drawer K-42
texts.objective.kaeltekammer.infiltrate: Infiltrate the evidence chamber & recover František's medallion before it is composted!
texts.hotspot.koje42.grinder.title: František's Coffee Grinder
texts.hotspot.koje42.grinder.line.0: Solid walnut and brass. Grandfather František rescued it from the old world fifty years ago.
texts.hotspot.koje42.grinder.line.1: He taught me to grind dried barley and roasted acorns... 'A Viennese without his coffee is no man, Novotny.'
texts.hotspot.koje42.grinder.line.2: In the double mill base: a pack of dry matches. I pocket them.
texts.hotspot.koje42.desk_supplies.title: František's Workbench
texts.hotspot.koje42.desk_supplies.line.0: A worn steel table with enamel dishes, folded wool sweaters and the brass oil lamp.
texts.hotspot.koje42.desk_supplies.line.1: A note under the lamp records unusual power fluctuations in Sector 0.
texts.hotspot.koje42.desk_supplies.line.2: František knew something was wrong in the cold chamber.
texts.hotspot.koje42.bed.title: The Empty Bunk
texts.hotspot.koje42.bed.line.0: The rough wool blanket is still crumpled. Last night he sat here humming an old song about the Vienna woods.
texts.hotspot.koje42.bed.line.1: His heavy leather boots still stand under the bed. He left them on purpose so his steps would be silent in the shaft.
texts.hotspot.koje42.terminal.title: Amtsrat 4.1 Field Computer
texts.hotspot.koje42.terminal.line.0: The armored bureau terminal Hawelka tossed to me. The screen flickers amber.
texts.hotspot.koje42.terminal.line.1: File GZ 2100-AZS/DEATH-0815 is sealed. Official cause: cardiovascular failure... Ordered by Hofrat Brandstätter.
texts.hotspot.koje42.door.title: The Sealed Corridor
texts.hotspot.koje42.door.line.0: Heavy steel bars hold the door shut from outside. Hawelka slammed it after the alarm.
texts.hotspot.koje42.door.line.1: Pollak's sluice guards patrol the corridor. Breaking out through the main door would be suicide.
texts.hotspot.koje42.vent.prompt: Open the vent grate & climb into the shaft
texts.hotspot.koje42.vent.title: The Secret Escape Route
texts.hotspot.koje42.vent.line.0: On the east wall, close above the damp floor: the heavy iron grate is already unscrewed.
texts.hotspot.koje42.vent.line.1: Icy ammonia air hisses up from behind it — the shaft leads straight into cold chamber K-42.
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.drawer_k42.title: Cold Chamber Drawer K-42
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.drawer_k42.line.0: With clammy fingers I pull the heavy steel trough from the wall... a gust of ice vapor hits me.
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.drawer_k42.line.1: František. His face is peaceful, almost pale as limestone. But as I push aside the collar of his coat...
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.drawer_k42.line.2: 🟢 [COLORKEY EMERALD GREEN] On the left side of his neck: a perfectly round, green-stained puncture. Not old age. Highly concentrated hydrocyanic acid.
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.drawer_k42.line.3: Chief Inspector Pollak murdered him! But why?! František's service ID and the medallion are missing... They must be in the evidence chamber of the chancellery!
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.ammonia.title: Nußdorf Cooling Line
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.ammonia.line.0: The loud hissing of the refrigerant pipes drowns my footsteps.
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.ammonia.line.1: If a pipe bursts here, the room fills with lethal ammonia gas within thirty seconds.
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.exit.prompt: Climb the service ladder to the evidence chamber
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.exit.title: The Way to the Chancellery
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.exit.line.0: A rusty wall ladder leads through the ceiling straight into the antechamber of the evidence room.
texts.hotspot.kaeltekammer.exit.line.1: There, all possessions of the dead are registered before the composting begins.
texts.map.flakturm_arenberg.title: Flakturm Arenbergpark
texts.map.flakturm_arenberg.subtitle: Scene 2 // Service tunnels & staircase ascent
texts.map.flakturm_arenberg.transit: Two hours through the flooded U3 service shaft. Only the steady dripping from the ceiling and the distant hum of the sluice ventilation accompany Novotny's steps.
texts.map.flakturm_arenberg.grandfatherNote: "The old flak tower still holds. The sluice guard can be bribed with filter coffee, but the water in the tunnel to Simmering stands knee-deep."
texts.map.flakturm_arenberg.archetypeQuote: "Show your pass 7b or get on the ground right now!"
texts.map.koje_42.title: Koje 42 (Grandfather's Quarters)
texts.map.koje_42.subtitle: Scene 1 // The prologue & grandfather's legacy
texts.map.koje_42.transit: Novotny descends the narrow spiral stairs into damp residential sector 4. The stench of carbide and musty linoleum fills the air.
texts.map.koje_42.grandfatherNote: "This is where it all began. The old coffee tin with my ashes stands under the cot. Carry it to the Central Cemetery, boy. Give me a proper burial."
texts.map.bermudadreieck.title: The Bermuda Triangle
texts.map.bermudadreieck.subtitle: Historic cellar vaults // alchemist's laboratory
texts.map.bermudadreieck.transit: Across the collapsed cellar vaults of Rotenturmstraße into the damp, sulfurous labyrinth of the Bermuda Triangle.
texts.map.bermudadreieck.grandfatherNote: "The poison mixers guard the last penicillin and anesthetics. Master Stephanus' ancient stills still run. Don't trust the medics — they feel no pain."
texts.map.bermudadreieck.archetypeQuote: "Penicillin for clean groundwater. If you can't pay, you get the pain blocker only after the leg is already gone."
texts.map.prater_riesenrad.title: Wurstelprater & Ferris Wheel
texts.map.prater_riesenrad.subtitle: The Kasperl bastion & black-market gambling dens
texts.map.prater_riesenrad.transit: Along the rusted Praterstern overpass. The distant, plaintive creak of the Ferris wheel cuts through the fog.
texts.map.prater_riesenrad.grandfatherNote: "The Kasperl gang guards the diesel generators with nail-studded boards and shotguns. Never look the croupiers in the eye too long."
texts.map.prater_riesenrad.archetypeQuote: "At the Prater the house always wins, boy."
texts.map.rossauer_kaserne.title: Rossauer Kaserne (The Super Bureau)
texts.map.rossauer_kaserne.subtitle: AZS headquarters // the fortress of bureaucracy
texts.map.rossauer_kaserne.transit: Past the machine-gun nests of the Danube Canal. Searchlights sweep the dark brick facades of the barracks.
texts.map.rossauer_kaserne.grandfatherNote: "Brandstätter's stronghold. Brick walls like a monolith on the Danube Canal. All the threads and the murderous AZS quotas converge here. Go there only once the ashes are buried."
texts.map.rossauer_kaserne.archetypeQuote: "Biomass belongs in the furnace. Objections are futile."
texts.map.zentralfriedhof.title: Vienna Central Cemetery (Gate 2)
texts.map.zentralfriedhof.subtitle: Honorary graves & crematorium // goal of the odyssey
texts.map.zentralfriedhof.transit: Five endless kilometers along the dusty rail lines of Simmering toward the south, into the incense mist of the undertakers.
texts.map.zentralfriedhof.grandfatherNote: "Gate 2. By the old linden trees. The gravediggers wear tailcoats and shotguns. Meet them with respect and they will open the hallowed burial earth."
texts.map.zentralfriedhof.archetypeQuote: "For AZS spies we dig six feet deep."
texts.map.safehouse_schellein.title: Safehouse Schelleingasse
texts.map.safehouse_schellein.subtitle: Abandoned student apartment // creator echo
texts.map.safehouse_schellein.transit: Novotny crawls through the barricaded light shaft into the silent, ivy-covered refuge of Schelleingasse.
texts.map.safehouse_schellein.grandfatherNote: "A dusty pre-war apartment near the old main station. Old manuscripts of a certain S.R. from the 1990s lie under the floorboards. A peaceful place."
texts.map.palais_metternich.title: Palais Metternich (The Consulate)
texts.map.palais_metternich.subtitle: Imperial ruins // the caste of diplomats
texts.map.palais_metternich.transit: Through the barbed-wire- and marble-rubble-lined avenues of the embassy quarter to the iron gate of Palais Metternich.
texts.map.palais_metternich.grandfatherNote: "The gentlemen diplomats in tailcoats. Cold as dog noses. They pay with pre-war gold and suppressed pistols if you empty their dead drops in the cemetery angels."
texts.map.palais_metternich.archetypeQuote: "An agreement is like the finest Meissen porcelain: fragile, but priceless."
texts.map.spittelau_fernwaerme.title: Spittelau District Heating Plant
texts.map.spittelau_fernwaerme.subtitle: The waste incinerator // the Aschenbrenner guild
texts.map.spittelau_fernwaerme.transit: Along the steaming district-heating pipes on the Danube Canal toward the north. Sulfur fumes and hot cinder rain herald the blast furnaces.
texts.map.spittelau_fernwaerme.grandfatherNote: "The golden sphere shines even through the soot. The Aschenbrenner control the steam pressure. Anger the chief stoker and you will sit in an icebox this winter."
texts.map.spittelau_fernwaerme.archetypeQuote: "As long as the fire burns, Vienna won't freeze. Bring coal or burn yourself."
texts.map.character_diorama.title: Character Diorama Studio
texts.map.character_diorama.subtitle: Scene 3 // 3D stage, PBR materials & rat FSM
texts.map.character_diorama.transit: Switch to the three-dimensional inspection room of the Character Diorama.
texts.map.character_diorama.grandfatherNote: "The creators' workbench. Here light refraction, iridescent oil lacquers and the grooming habits of Vienna's canal rats are tested."
